chapter_seo_title: Immortal Fortunes Assembly – Ji Ning Teams with Yu Wei, Sanpang Unleashes Black Tortoise
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning and Yu Wei dominate the Brightmoon Landscape World together, but a lazy fatty named Sanpang shocks everyone with a top-100 divine ability—the Black Tortoise. The Xia Emperor takes notice.
og_title: A Sleepy Fat Guy Just Broke the Immortal Fortunes Assembly
og_description: Ji Ning and Yu Wei’s duo is fire, but Sanpang’s Black Tortoise Divine Ability steals the show. The whole hall of Pure Yang True Immortals is stunned.
twitter_title: Hidden monster Sanpang reveals Black Tortoise divine ability!
twitter_description: Power-couple Ji Ning & Yu Wei farm tokens, but a lazy cave-gnawing fatty with a legendary divine ability steals the spotlight at the Immortal Fortunes Assembly.

lore_anchors.definition: A pocket-realm painting used as the arena for the final stage of the Immortal Fortunes Assembly, designed to simulate a vast wilderness where contestants hunt each other for token talismans.
A badge of qualification in the Immortal Fortunes Assembly; contestants collect tokens from defeated or killed opponents to advance to the next round.
The Black-White College’s third-generation senior disciple, a slovenly fatty who hides his immense power behind a lazy, bone-chewing facade and wields the legendary Black Tortoise Divine Ability.

One of the top one hundred divine abilities since Pangu, originating from the Black Tortoise Grand Emperor of the Three Realms; it manifests as a turtle-snake phantom and grants terrifying physical power and defensive properties.
A top-tier sect based in the Eastern Seas, far stronger than the Black-White College, specializing in beast-related secret arts and with hundreds of Loose Immortals and Earth Immortals.
A cultivator who has transcended the Nine Tribulations and achieved a state of pure, immortal yang energy; they can observe all events inside the Brightmoon Landscape World without entering.
A special cultivation technique that grants supernatural powers ranked by their origin and power; the Black Tortoise Divine Ability is considered among the supreme ones since the age of Pangu.
